messages.subject: different results from ezANOVA and stats aov
parts:

+   dv = ACC,

messages.subject: Re: [ez4r] different results from ezANOVA and stats aov
parts: Another mistake: I had changed the data frame to eliminate subsets of data to balance it, and did not re-factorize the independent variables. Once I did that, the stats code matched ez.
